design_concept: Editorial Dark: A sophisticated, magazine-style layout tailored for a software engineering portfolio. High contrast, sharp typography (serif/mono pairing), narrow reading columns, and a focus on narrative structure. Complete avoidance of generic tech gradients (no purple/violet).
file_extension_guidance: Use .js or .jsx for all React components. Do not use TypeScript (.tsx).

rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-light tracking-tight font-serif
rules.h2: text-3xl md:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-light tracking-tight font-serif

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. Sections should use py-24 or py-32. Elements within sections gap-8 or gap-12.
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Editorial narrow columns for text. About me text should be constrained (max-w-2xl) to act like a magazine column. Project grids should be asymmetrical (e.g., alternating between col-span-8 and col-span-4).
layout_and_spacing.corners: Sharp (rounded-none) or very subtle (rounded-sm) to maintain the Swiss Brutalist / Editorial edge. No soft large radii.

components.buttons: Flat, sharp-edged. primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-neutral-200. secondary: border border-neutral-800 text-white hover:bg-neutral-900.
components.cards: Cardless approach or 1px subtle border (border-neutral-800) with flat background (bg-neutral-900). No drop shadows, rely on borders.
components.navigation: Sticky, crystal glassmorphism (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10).
components.contact_form: Minimalist inputs. border-b only or sharp outlined inputs (border-neutral-800 bg-transparent focus:border-white focus:ring-0).

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Subtle border color change, slight opacity shifts. Images can be grayscale by default, color on hover.

images.description: Abstract dark architecture for the hero section background (overlay heavily).

sections_instructions.hero: Name: Bernardo Borges. Title: Software Engineer. Use the background image with a heavy black overlay (bg-black/80). Large serif typography. Minimalist scroll indicator.
sections_instructions.about: Editorial text column. Max width 2xl. Tell the story of a College Graduate in Software Engineering.
sections_instructions.skills: List programming languages, frameworks, tools using minimal mono-spaced tags.
sections_instructions.experience: Timeline layout. Minimalist vertical line with sharp nodes.
sections_instructions.projects: Showcase the 4 projects in an asymmetrical grid. Hovering over a project card should reveal the image with full opacity.
sections_instructions.education: Similar to experience, clean editorial list.
sections_instructions.contact: Form to store in MongoDB. Must have data-testid on inputs and submit button.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testids: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-button').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards on dark backgrounds.
